title: StereoDetect: Detecting Stereotypes and Anti-stereotypes the Correct Way Using Social Psychological Underpinnings

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the capability of models to classify text involving gender groups into stereotype, anti-stereotype, bias, or neutral categories using zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought prompting, as well as fine-tuning, measured via F1-scores.
